listings.provider: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Sports Authority of India (SAI), NCERT & NTA
listings.eligibility: Students across all classes in recognized schools in Haryana; each school nominates at least 2 students for the NTA online preliminary round to compete in the State and National rounds.
listings.benefit: Total Rs 3.25 Crore prize pool: Haryana State Champion wins Rs 2,50,000 for the school + Rs 25,000 for the 2-student team (Rs 12,500/student); National Champion wins Rs 25,00,000 for the school + Rs 2,50,000 for the 2-student team (Rs 1,25,000/student); National 1st Runner-Up wins Rs 15L school + Rs 1.5L team; 2nd Runner-Up wins Rs 10L school + Rs 1L team.
listings.fee: Rs 50 to Rs 100 per student nomination fee (paid by school)
prepare_steps: Schools register their nominated students through the Fit India / NCERT / NTA quiz portal.
listings.notes: Rewards both the participating students and their school with major sports infrastructure cash grants. Application window: Annual cycle from September to December (NTA Preliminaries in Nov/Dec; State & National finals in Jan-Feb).
